question: brakes-atlas
answer:

### Order list (front right)
| Article number | Part to order | Notes / position |
|---|---|---|
| **VP-10176** | Brake disc, front right | 400 mm ventilated brake disc **[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]** |
| **VP-10267** | Brake pad set, front axle | Set of 4 pads (covers left + right on the front axle) **[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]** |

| **VP-10657** | Brake hose, front right | Reinforced flexible hose with banjo fitting **[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]** |
| **VP-10683** | Pad wear sensor, front right | Electrical pad wear sensor **[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]** |
| **VP-10709** | Caliper fitting kit, front axle | Slide pins, bolts and anti rattle clips for one side **[voltrieve-parts-brakes.md]** |

## Left front (Fjord AWD) – parts list (with article numbers)
- **Brake disc, front left (370 mm ventilated)** - Qty 1 - **VP-10072** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Brake pad set, front axle (covers left + right sides of axle)** - Qty 1 - **VP-10254** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Brake caliper, front left (twin piston floating, for 370 mm disc)** - Qty 1 - **VP-10345** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Caliper carrier, front left** - Qty 1 - **VP-10527** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Brake hose, front left** - Qty 1 - **VP-10631** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Pad wear sensor, front left** - Qty 1 - **VP-10670** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Caliper fitting kit, front axle (slide pins/bolts/anti-rattle clips for one side)** - Qty 1 - **VP-10709** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Brake dust shield, front left** - Qty 1 - **VP-10761** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)
- **Brake fluid DOT 4 LV (for bleeding afterwards)** - Qty 1 - **VP-15168** (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**, **Source: “voltrieve-parts-brakes.md”**)

If you want, tell me whether you’re replacing only “wear parts” (disc + pads) or truly swapping **caliper/hose/sensor too**-but the list above is what the documentation specifies for a *complete* left-front front-brake replacement. (**Source: “voltrieve-service-guide.md”**)
